name: Now reading
description: An open book with smoked-glass pages, its lines of text drawn as rows of hexagonal fluorescent segments: lit teal up to the reading position halfway down the right page and faintly visible beyond it, with an orange bookmark annunciator.
choices: The display’s ghosted unlit segments become the unread part of the page, so the book shows how far you have got
One orange annunciator, a bookmark, is the only second colour; no digits or lettering
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
